# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:claude/claude-opus-4-6

## Summary

The save-schema versioning and migration scaffolding is well-implemented and robust. Key strengths: (1) compile-time assertion ensures MIGRATIONS array stays in sync with SCHEMA_VERSION, (2) u32::try_from prevents silent truncation of oversized schema versions, (3) sequential migration chain with explicit error reporting on malformed legacy payloads, (4) thorough documentation of the migration contract for future contributors, (5) post-migration carbonate normalization and stability tracker reconciliation handle edge cases gracefully. All 15 save_load tests pass. The one test failure (hatch_produces_juveniles) is a pre-existing simulation tuning issue unrelated to this work. The dead SchemaVersionMismatch variant from a prior review was already removed. The API handler correctly uses the new from_value path. No correctness bugs, safety problems, or significant maintainability risks found.

## Amendments

None.
